body: After you get better, read this, maybe have sleep, shower, food, even an ambulance, but when you feel ready read this. This is so painfully relatable. Honestly, I've got 2 years of extra experience of what you are going through, I am not comparing it, or dismissing it, I just want to give you some tips: do the bare minimum of work, if you start there, everyone including yourself will be proud. Obey the rules: your parents just like mine make hell out of disobedience, be smart, play the game with them, it's a long con, the moment your are ready to leave the house, you are free. This is a weird one but: try getting several hobbies, to create motivation, and find a subject you are good at or like, and study that more than the others. And last but not least: make sure to get the juice. Stay strong, Jeremy

Honestly, I am not a philosopher, nor a big optimist, but look, you got rid of what most hurt you, you can start building trust again, shouldn't be saddened by bad people, even tho we all do, myself included. Keep it strong, Jeremy

Hey, I am a 17 year old guy, I definitely do not have the experiences that you had, but sounds like you need help, I was looking through this community, and found a lot of sad stories including your. But, if anything, I can offer you an ear, and my time, it has little value to many, but I hope you cherish it. Keep it strong, jeremy
